title: DFT structural relaxation
action: Relax the crystal structure of ZrTe5 (space group Cmcm) using DFT to obtain equilibrium lattice parameters and atomic positions.
description: Relaxation of the bulk unit cell; required before any property calculation.

title: Phonon calculation at Γ
action: Using DFPT or finite displacements on the relaxed structure, compute phonon frequencies and eigenvectors at the Γ point, identifying the six Ag Raman-active modes and their atomic displacement vectors.
description: Obtain the Ag normal-mode eigenvectors required to construct distorted structures in later steps.

title: Generate distorted structures along Ag normal coordinates
action: For each of the six Ag modes, generate atomic geometries with displacements along the normal coordinate Q in the range -0.6 to 0.3 (step no larger than 0.1). Also produce a 2D grid of structures for combinations of Q27 and Q31 covering the same range (at least 7x7 points).
description: Create the set of distorted structure input files needed for the topological phase evolution calculations.

title: Equilibrium SOC band gap
action: Perform a DFT electronic structure calculation with spin-orbit coupling on the relaxed equilibrium structure; extract the fundamental band gap at the Γ point and write it to equilibrium_gap.txt.
description: Single floating-point number representing the Γ-point SOC band gap in eV.
output_schema: A text file containing a single floating-point number on the first line (unit: eV).

title: Band gap and topological phase vs Q for all Ag modes
action: For every distorted structure generated in step3 (all six Ag modes, full Q range), run a DFT+SOC band calculation; extract the Γ-point band gap and determine the topological phase (STI or WTI) using the Z2 invariant or a clear band inversion indicator. Output the results as a CSV.
description: Per-mode gap and topological phase as function of Q; demonstrates which modes drive a gap closure and phase transition.
output_schema: CSV with columns: mode_name (string, e.g. Ag6, Ag22, Ag25, Ag27, Ag29, Ag36), Q (float, dimensionless normal coordinate), gap_meV (float, positive number, meV), topological_phase (string, either 'STI' or 'WTI').

title: 2D phase diagram for A_g-27 and A_g-31
action: For the 2D grid of (Q27, Q31) structures from step3, compute the Γ-point band gap and topological phase; output a CSV.
description: Phase diagram in (A_g-27, A_g-31) space, showing the Dirac topology line.
output_schema: CSV with columns: Q27 (float), Q31 (float), gap_meV (float), topological_phase (string, 'STI' or 'WTI').
